title: UISD Board Elects Molina President in 4-3 Vote at First Meeting of New Board
excerpt: The United ISD Board of Trustees elected Michelle Molina as board president at its November 18 meeting, approving the leadership slate 4-3 after newly seated trustees challenged the picks.
content:
The United Independent School District Board of Trustees elected Michelle Molina as board president at its regular meeting on Wednesday, November 18, approving the leadership slate on a 4-3 vote.

Under the slate that passed, Molina will serve as president, Rudy Gonzalez as vice president and Gilbert Aguilar as secretary.

The vote was the new board's first major leadership decision. Leticia “Letty” Juarez, sworn in November 11 as the District 5 trustee, offered an alternative motion to name Dianelle Martinez president and Molina vice president. Martinez, the District 7 trustee, raised attendance concerns during the debate, citing her review of board meetings dating back to November 2024 — 21 absences for Molina, 15 for Aguilar and 17 for Gonzalez — and asking how trustees could demand consistent attendance from employees and students while not meeting that same standard themselves.

Victor Vasquez, the newly elected District 3 trustee, also opposed the Molina slate, warning that the choice could further divide the board rather than bring it together.

The alternative motion failed, and the original leadership slate passed with three trustees opposed.

Molina was reelected November 3 to represent District 6. Juarez and Vasquez joined the seven-member board after winning their seats in the same election, alongside Martinez, who joined the board in 2024.

Source: United ISD Board of Trustees meeting, Nov. 18, 2026.
